description: Window controls, tray and zoom for the injected title bar, which is DOM inside the remote dsh page - so that page's own origin has to be allowed to invoke them. Scoped to loopback: this is where the dsh web server binds, and dsh refuses any other host, so a dsh page served from elsewhere gets no title bar rather than a window it should not control. Four window commands, one tray command, two zoom commands and two self-diagnosis commands. No fs, shell, clipboard or path access.
